summary: SAML assertion local_time/timezone offset claim mis-parsed by tenant resolver causing 403s in private deployment
description:
Issue summary:
Customer reports that users in their private VPC deployment intermittently receive 403 when attempting to access the admin console. Failures started after an IdP config change last week.

Impact:
- Multiple NimbusHealth tenant admins cannot access admin routes (403) for ~40% of login attempts.
- Affects production us-west tenant only.
- Workaround is manual re-login which sometimes succeeds.

Environment:
- Redwood Private (customer-managed control plane) deployed in us-west; identity-proxy v1.11.9; tenant resolver v2.3.
- IdP: Okta SAML, customer recently added a custom attribute 'local_time' in assertion containing timezone offset (e.g. "2026-03-10T08:45:00-07:00").

Steps to reproduce:
1. IdP issues SAML assertion with custom 'local_time' claim (string ISO with timezone offset).
2. Identity-proxy receives assertion and forwards normalized claim set to tenant resolver.
3. Tenant resolver attempts to canonicalize claims and lookup tenant by prefix derived from 'tenant_hint' claim.
4. Request intermittently fails and returns 403 with "tenant resolution failed" in gateway logs.

Observed behavior:
- Requests fail during tenant lookup; logs show parsing errors where tenant resolver attempts numeric conversion of claim values.
- When the same user retries immediately, request sometimes succeeds (race depending on which proxy route is used).

Expected behavior:
- Identity-proxy should ignore extra time-related custom claims when resolving tenant and RBAC, or normalize them safely without throwing parsing errors.
steps_to_reproduce: Configure Okta SAML to add attribute 'local_time' with ISO+offset string to assertion
Login via SSO from a browser behind customer's ingress
Observe 403s in admin route logs and see tenant resolver parse errors
logs: 2026-03-10T13:14:21Z identity-proxy[ingress] WARN tenant-resolver: claim parse error: invalid literal for int() with base 10: '2026-03-10T08:45:00-07:00' (src/tenant_resolver/normalize.py:87)
2026-03-10T13:14:21Z gateway ERROR auth: tenant resolution failed, returning 403 (request_id=abc-123)
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden - X-Request-Id: abc-123 - tenant_lookup_err=ValueError('invalid literal')
comments: 2026-03-10 14:02 - NimbusHealth support (Priya R.): Reporting admins intermittently hit 403 after IdP added a 'local_time' attribute. We started seeing this after the IdP change on 2026-03-09.

2026-03-10 14:10 - Support (Asha N.): Thanks Priya — we've triaged this to the private control plane. Assigning SRE. Can you share a full SAML assertion (redact PHI) and timestamp of a failed attempt?

2026-03-10 15:05 - NimbusHealth (Priya R.): Uploaded SAML (redacted) to secure link. Failed attempt timestamp: 2026-03-10T13:14:21Z. Link: https://s3.redwood-support/nimbus/saml/ssn-1 (access granted to team)

2026-03-10 16:30 - SRE (Diego M.): Reproduced locally with assertion copy. Tenant resolver raised ValueError trying to cast claim 'local_time'. Suspect claim normalization expects numeric-only claims in a small set and falls back to error on unexpected formats. Adding engineering investigation.
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: tenant resolver has aggressive claim canonicalization that attempts int() conversion for claims not present in whitelist, and a malformed regex allowed the 'local_time' claim to be tried as numeric.
Reproducer: unit test added that injects 'local_time' == '2026-03-10T08:45:00-07:00' into assertion -> tenant_resolver.normalize() throws ValueError exactly as in prod logs.

Ingress path difference: intermittent success correlates with requests routed to a path that uses claim_whitelist configuration; failing path uses older normalization code (race between two identity-proxy replicas with different configs).

Found code: src/tenant_resolver/normalize.py line 72-90: naive conversion of non-whitelisted claims using int() without try/except. Previously worked because no non-numeric extra claims were present. The IdP change added time-with-offset string, triggering the exception.
Customer confirmation: they enabled 'Add local time attribute' across all apps on 2026-03-09; start of errors matches cadence.
Temporary mitigation attempted: toggling identity-proxy replica config to enforce claim_whitelist on both replicas reduced failures to ~0.5% (from ~40%).
resolution: Root cause: tenant resolver's claim normalization attempted numeric conversion on extra SAML attributes; new 'local_time' ISO+offset string from IdP caused ValueError and aborted tenant lookup leading to 403.

Hotfix applied: patched normalize.py to defensively parse claims and skip conversion on non-whitelisted keys; added try/except and logging instead of raising (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/identity-proxy/pull/421).

Release: rolled out identity-proxy v1.12.3 to NimbusHealth private control plane on 2026-03-12 04:00 UTC, gradual rollout across 4 replicas with config pin to ensure consistent claim_whitelist enforcement.
Post-release validation: monitored admin login attempts for 48h — failures dropped to baseline (<0.5% attributable to unrelated network retries).

Follow-ups: update Private SSO runbook to include guidance on custom attribute formats; add unit tests for ISO time strings and timezone offsets; schedule release of new config-compatibility check to detect mixed replica configs in private control plane.
